profile.title: Add the branch's address and description
profile.why: Customers see these first on your booking page.
lines: Open Branch settings in the left menu.
Fill in the address and province, and write a short description.
Add a phone number and a map link if you like, and choose a branch photo.
Press Save.

sport.title: Add a sport
sport.why: Every space, coach and class belongs to a sport.
lines: Open Setup in the left menu, then the Sports tab.
Press Add sport.
Type a name such as Tennis, and choose the type of sport.
Press Save.

court.title: Add a space (court, pitch, ring…)
court.why: A space is the thing customers book. Each one is booked on its own.
lines: Open Setup, then the Spaces tab.
Press Add space.
Choose the sport and the type, and name it, for example Court 1.
Press Save.

hoursPrice.title: Give a space opening hours and a price
hoursPrice.why: Without both, nobody can book the space yet.
lines: Open Setup, then Spaces, and open the space you just added.
In Opening hours, set when it is open each day and press Save opening hours. Copy Monday to every day saves time.
In Price, enter the price per hour and press Save price.

publish.title: Publish and share
publish.why: Your booking page goes live and you get one link to share.
lines: Go back to Overview once the four steps are done.
Press Publish booking page. Only the owner or an admin can.
Share the link or the QR code on Facebook, WhatsApp or LINE. Bookings appear in your dashboard.

area.title: Add an area
area.why: An area is a part of the place with its own floor plan, for example Indoor or Terrace.
lines: Open Setup, then the Floor plan tab.
Press Add area.
Name it, for example Indoor, and keep the size 20 × 12 unless the room is very big.
Press Save.

table.title: Add your tables
table.why: Customers choose a table on the floor plan, so each table needs its seats and its place.
lines: On the Floor plan tab, press Add table.
Give it a name (T1) and its seats, then press Add table.
Drag it to where it stands. Repeat for every table.
Press Save floor plan.

venueHours.title: Set the opening hours
venueHours.why: Customers can book a table only while the place is open.
lines: Open Setup, then the Opening hours tab.
Set the hours of each day, for example 17:00 to 24:00.
Press Save opening hours.

p: When you create an account or book, we keep your name, phone number and email address, and the details of your bookings (what, when, where and the price).
If you sign in with Google or Facebook, we receive your name, email address and profile name from them. We never see your Google or Facebook password and we do not post anything on your behalf.
We use it only to run your bookings: to confirm or cancel them, to email you about them and to let the branch you booked with serve you.
We do not sell your data and we do not use it for advertising.
The managers and staff of the branch you book with, and the company owners and admins, can see your name, contact details and bookings.
We use an email service to send booking and password emails, and a storage service for uploaded pictures. They receive only what they need to do that.
We keep your account and bookings while your account is open. When you ask us to delete your data, we remove your personal details; see the data deletion page.
You can update your name and contact details in My account. You can ask for a copy of your data or for its deletion at any time by writing to {{email}}.

To delete your account and personal data, send us a message at {{email}} from the email address of your account, or tell the branch you booked with. Please write "Delete my data" and the phone number or email on your account.
If you signed up with Facebook or Google, you can also remove this app from your Facebook or Google account settings; then write to us so we delete what we hold.
We delete your name, phone number, email address and sign-in links within 30 days and tell you when it is done.
Past bookings may be kept without your personal details, because the branch needs them for its records and reports.

sharePage.notLiveLead: Finish the steps on the Overview and publish the page; then its link and QR code appear here.

upcoming.title: Coming up
upcoming.lead: Bookings of the next 7 days that are still to come.

tonight.title: Today's tables
tonight.empty: No tables yet. Add them in Setup → Floor plan.
tonight.tapHint: Tap a table to change it.

events.title: Events
events.lead: A concert or a special night: its tables are sold at a price and paid before the night, instead of free booking that day.
events.empty: No events yet. Make one to sell tables for a special night.
events.deleteHint: An event nobody booked is deleted. One with bookings is only unpublished.
events.copied: Event copied. It is not published yet.
events.name: Name
events.moreDaysHint: Off: the event is one day.
events.adHint: The ad shows on the home and branch pages while the event is published. Without one, the background is used.
events.defaultPriceHint: Every table without its own price. 0 = not for sale.
events.holdHint: Unpaid tables go back on sale after this: 15 minutes up to 7 days (60 = 1 hour, 1440 = 1 day). Staff can cancel any time.
events.bigHint: More than {{n}} tables must be paid within {{m}} minutes.
events.publishHint: Customers see the ad and can buy tables.
events.copyLead: Makes a new, unpublished event with the same prices.
events.pricesLead: The price of a zone applies to every table inside it. A price on one table wins.
events.zonesHint: Colour areas you drew on the floor plan.
events.tablesHint: Leave empty to use the zone or default price.

pay.title: How customers pay
pay.lead: Shown after a customer buys tables or a package: they pay by QR or transfer, then send the slip.
pay.whatsappHint: Customers tap a button that opens WhatsApp to this number.
pay.onlineHint: Customers pay in their bank app and the booking confirms itself. No staff step.
pay.noGateway: Not available yet: the server has no payment gateway set up (PhaJay keys).
pay.transferHint: Customers pay your own QR or bank account and send you the slip. You confirm it.
pay.noWay: Both are off: customers cannot pay on the website. They have to contact the branch, and you confirm each booking by hand.
pay.accountHint: Customers see the name and the number, each with a copy button. Put the bank name in the extra text below.
pay.window: Time to pay after choosing a bank
pay.windowHint_one: The QR stays open for {{count}} minute and the tables are held that long (plus a few minutes). Then the customer picks a bank again.
pay.windowHint_other: The QR stays open for {{count}} minutes and the tables are held that long (plus a few minutes). Then the customer picks a bank again.
pay.slipLead: After paying by transfer, the customer sends the payment slip. Choose how they can send it.
pay.slipTelegram: Upload the slip on the website
pay.slipTelegramHint: The customer picks a photo of the slip and it goes straight to your team's Telegram group. The customer never sees the group.
pay.slipWhatsappHint: A button opens WhatsApp to the number above, with the booking code and amount filled in.
pay.slipNone: No way to send a slip is on. Customers will have to tell your team another way.
pay.switchBookingHint: Courts, rooms and classes. Off: customers book for free and pay at the venue, and no "Pay online" box is shown after booking.
pay.switchPackageHint: Buying a package. Off: customers send a slip or pay at the desk.

events.timeHint: Optional, the same every day. An end earlier than the start means after midnight (19:00 – 01:00).
events.areasAll: Nothing ticked: the whole branch. Normal table booking is off that day.
events.areasSome: Areas you do not tick are booked the normal way that day.
events.lineupHint: The program customers see. Leave “To” empty for “until the end”.
events.acceptGuestsHint: On: anyone can buy tables, as the branch allows. Off: customers must log in first. A branch that takes accounts only always needs a login.

eventPay.title: Waiting for payment
eventPay.lead_one: {{count}} event booking waits for the money. Check the slip, then confirm it paid or release the tables.
eventPay.lead_other: {{count}} event bookings wait for the money. Check the slip, then confirm each one paid or release its tables.
eventPay.slipAtLong: The customer said they sent the slip on {{when}}. The hold no longer runs out by itself: check it, then mark it paid.
eventPay.noSlipLong: No slip yet. The tables go back on sale by themselves when the time is up.
eventPay.releaseHint: Release: the booking is cancelled and the tables go back on sale at once.

payOnline.title: Pay online
payOnline.lead: Pay {{total}} in your bank app. The booking confirms itself once the payment arrives.
payOnline.otherBankHint: Opens a page where you choose the bank
payOnline.timeUp: Time is up. Please do not pay this QR any more.
payOnline.timeUpFinal: Time is up. Your booking is being cancelled and the tables are released. Please do not pay this QR any more.
payOnline.newQr: Choose a bank to get a new QR
payOnline.confirmLead: Once the QR is made you cannot change the bank. If you pick the wrong one, you have to cancel this booking and book again.
payOnline.confirmLeadLink: You choose the bank on the payment page. Once it is made you cannot switch to a QR for another bank here.
payOnline.startOverLead: This cancels this booking and releases the tables. You go back to the same tables to book again and pick another bank. Do not do this if you already paid.
payOnline.preparing: Creating your {{bank}} QR. This takes a few seconds…
payOnline.paid: Paid — thank you! Your booking is confirmed.

ended.expired: That payment ran out of time. Choose a bank to try again.
ended.failed: The bank could not start that payment. Try another bank.
ended.review: We received a payment that needs the team to look at it. Please contact the branch.

payOnline.saveQrHint: Paying on this phone? Save the QR, open your bank app and choose “scan from gallery”.
payOnline.leadPackage: Pay {{total}} in your bank app. Your package starts once the payment arrives.

payStatus.title: Online payments
payStatus.refundConfirm: The bank is asked to give the money back to the customer. This cannot be undone. The booking is not cancelled by this.
payStatus.refundAsked: Refund asked. It shows as refunded when the bank confirms.
payStatus.attentionLead: Money to give back, amounts that did not match, disputes and refunds in progress. Tap the code to open the booking.

telegram.title: Telegram
telegram.lead: Send new bookings to your team's Telegram group.
telegram.step1: In Telegram, talk to @BotFather, make a bot and copy its token.
telegram.step2: Paste the token below and press Connect bot.
telegram.step3: Add the bot to your staff group, and add your staff and admins to that group.
telegram.step4: Press “Find my groups” and pick your group from the list.
telegram.step5: Press “Send a test message”, then switch the messages on.
telegram.tokenHint: The token is kept encrypted on the server and is never shown again. Anyone with it can use your bot, so do not share it.
telegram.noGroup: No group chosen yet. Add the bot to your staff group first, then press the button (the bot only sees groups from the last day).
telegram.testSent: Test message sent. Look in your group.
telegram.disconnectLead: The bot token and the group are forgotten and the group stops getting messages. You can connect again any time.
telegram.messagesLead: What the group hears about. Bookings that staff make themselves are not sent.
telegram.enabledHint: The master switch. Off: nothing is sent.
telegram.notReady: Connect a bot and a group first.
telegram.bookingHint: A customer books a court, a class or a table.
telegram.eventHint: A customer buys tables for an event.
telegram.paymentHint: An online payment arrives, or a customer says they sent the slip.
telegram.cancelHint: A customer cancels, or an unpaid event booking is released.
telegram.hidePhoneHint: Leave the customer's phone number and email out of the messages.
telegram.groupsFound: Groups the bot saw (latest first). Pick the one for this branch:

slip.uploadHint: Take or choose a photo of your transfer slip.
slip.sent: Thank you. The team will check your payment.
slip.sentPicture: Slip sent. The team will check it and confirm your payment.

packages.title: Packages
packages.lead: Passes you sell next to single bookings: a number of visits, or unlimited for some months. A customer books with a pass and pays nothing more.
packages.empty: No packages yet. Add one, for example Group class: 10 times for 900,000.
packages.name: Name

coversHints.group_class: Pays a seat in the group classes of this sport.
coversHints.space: Pays a booking of one space, for example a private class. A coach is not included.

packages.noSpaces: This sport has no space yet. Add one in Spaces first.
packages.optionsHint: Each option has its own price: for example 10 times 900,000, 20 times 1,850,000, 1 month 700,000.
packages.onSaleHint: Off hides the whole package from customers.
packages.deleteHint: Customers who already bought it keep what they bought.
packages.slipTelegram: Slip sent: check your team's Telegram group (look for the code), then mark it paid.
packages.slipWhatsapp: The customer says they sent the slip on WhatsApp: check it, then mark it paid.
packages.cancelHint: The customer can no longer pay for it.
packages.cancelPaidHint: The package stops working. Giving money back is for you to settle outside the app.
packages.soldLead: What customers bought. Sell one at the desk, mark a transfer as paid, add or remove visits.
packages.search: Search by name, phone or code
packages.paidDone: Marked paid. The package is ready to use.
packages.sellLead: Sell a package to a customer who has an account.
packages.nothingToSell: There is no package on sale yet.
packages.notPaidHint: It waits for payment: mark it paid later.
packages.adjustLead: Add or remove visits, or give more days. A reason is required and kept in the history.
packages.adjustVisitsHint: {{left}} left now, {{after}} after saving. Tap - to remove, + to add.
packages.adjustNothing: Add or remove visits or days.

public.title: Packages
public.lead: Buy a pass and book without paying each time.
public.confirmLead: You pay on the next step.

my.title: My packages
my.slipChecking: Slip sent. The team is checking it.
my.payLead: It starts as soon as it is paid.

methodHints.online: Scan a bank QR in your bank app. Your package starts by itself.
methodHints.manual: Transfer to the branch, then send the slip.

my.noWay: Online payment is off. Please pay at the place and tell the team your code.
my.paidNote: Paid. Your package is ready: choose it when you book.
my.slipMessage: Package {{code}} {{name}}, {{total}}. Here is my payment slip.
my.tellDesk: Pay at the place and tell the team your code {{code}}.

find.title: Find a package
find.lead: A customer says their code, phone number or name: type it here and open their package.
find.resultsLead: Mark paid, adjust or read the history right here.
find.none: No package found. Check the code or the phone number.

packages.paymentsMoved: How customers pay (online, bank QR, slip) is set in

common.offlineStale: Cannot reach the server. The list below may be old.
